scope_limits.runtime_jsonl: 4 experiment JSONL files/640 rows checked for structure and IDs, not claimed as source full reads

manual_path_rebinding.reason: Explicit current checkout path supplied to bridge and holdout checks.

tests.legacy_failure_cause: Installed transformers 4.49.0 does not export Qwen3Config; requirements expect >=4.56.0

issues.finding: HEAD_KEYS omits support_logits; online support_parent=floor becomes absent on stored-head replay.
request_to_condition uses default max_objects=128 before loading a checkpoint; 129 objects reject by default but succeed with explicit max_objects=256.

Eligibility excludes support/expected_geometry; enabling only either new loss causes _preflight to reject otherwise supervised rows. Current E config also has base losses, so its normal run is not blocked by this.
Existing room_N.json success is reused without binding rows/model/method; hybrid replaces RUN.json before cache reuse.
CLI accepts fewer than four GPUs, but final phases index g[1],g[2],g[3].
Some scoring/report failures are not propagated into final failed status.
V2_ROOT assumes fastfill-main subdirectory absent in this checkout; two integration tests skip.

New v4fixes.py omitted from builder/QA implementation dependency fingerprints; build_v2 second read lacks whole-build input/code hash stability verification. Relevant when inputs or implementation change during build.
